description.en: Carboxylic acids are acidic because the carboxylate ion formed after the loss of a proton is highly stabilized by resonance. The negative charge is delocalized equally over two highly electronegative oxygen atoms.
description.hi: कार्बोक्सिलिक अम्ल अम्लीय होते हैं क्योंकि एक प्रोटॉन के नुकसान के बाद बनने वाला कार्बोक्सिलेट आयन अनुनाद द्वारा अत्यधिक स्थिर होता है। ऋणात्मक आवेश दो अत्यधिक विद्युत्-ऋणात्मक ऑक्सीजन परमाणुओं पर समान रूप से विस्थानिकृत (delocalized) हो जाता है।
description.hinglish: Carboxylic acids acidic hote hain kyunki proton nikalne ke baad jo carboxylate ion banta hai wo resonance se highly stable hota hai. Negative charge dono electronegative oxygen atoms par equally delocalize ho jata hai.

<svg viewBox="0 0 600 250" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Structure 1 -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 50)">
    <text x="0" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">R</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="72" x2="50" y2="72" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="60" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">C</text>
    
    <!-- Double bond O up -->
    <line x1="70" y1="50" x2="70" y2="20" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="80" y1="50" x2="80" y2="20" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="65" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
    
    <!-- Single bond O- right -->
    <line x1="85" y1="72" x2="115" y2="72" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="125" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
    <!-- Negative charge -->
    <circle cx="145" cy="60" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="141" y1="60" x2="149" y2="60" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Arrow showing electron movement -->
    <path d="M 135 65 Q 110 40 90 60" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <path d="M 75 25 Q 100 10 95 -10" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Resonance Arrow -->
  <g transform="translate(240, 110)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="50" y2="0" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="3" marker-start="url(#arrow-rev)" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Structure 2 -->
  <g transform="translate(320, 50)">
    <text x="0" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">R</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="72" x2="50" y2="72" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="60" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">C</text>
    
    <!-- Single bond O- up -->
    <line x1="75" y1="50" x2="75" y2="20" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="65" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
    <!-- Negative charge -->
    <circle cx="90" cy="-5" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="86" y1="-5" x2="94" y2="-5" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Double bond O right -->
    <line x1="85" y1="67" x2="115" y2="67" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="85" y1="77" x2="115" y2="77" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="125" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Equivalent Resonance Hybrid -->
  <g transform="translate(180, 180)">
    <text x="0" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#6b7280">≡ Resonance Hybrid:</text>
    
    <g transform="translate(180, -70)">
      <text x="0" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">R</text>
      <line x1="20" y1="72" x2="50" y2="72" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
      <text x="60" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">C</text>
      
      <!-- Partial bond up -->
      <line x1="75" y1="50" x2="75" y2="20" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
      <line x1="85" y1="50" x2="85" y2="20" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
      <text x="65" y="10" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
      <text x="95" y="0" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#10b981">δ-</text>

      <!-- Partial bond right -->
      <line x1="85" y1="72" x2="115" y2="72" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3" />
      <line x1="85" y1="62" x2="115" y2="62" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
      <text x="125" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
      <text x="150" y="70" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#10b981">δ-</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow markers def -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#2563eb" />
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-rev" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="1" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 10 0 L 0 5 L 10 10 z" fill="#4b5563" />
    </marker>
  </defs>
</svg>
